projects.title: AI Lead Qualification & CRM Automation
projects.description: A six-stage n8n workflow that receives web-form leads, normalizes incoming data, uses an OpenAI model to classify each lead into one of three priority levels (Hot, Warm, or Cold), records the result in Google Sheets, sends an acknowledgement email, and notifies the team according to priority.
projects.contribution: My contribution: I designed and configured the workflow steps and the connections between the form, OpenAI, Google Sheets, and Gmail.
projects.outcome: Measured scope: six connected workflow stages and three lead-priority categories. The workflow centralizes lead records and routes follow-up notifications; processing-time and time-saved benchmarks have not been measured.

projects.title: AI Customer Support Email Agent
projects.description: A six-stage n8n workflow for customer-support email: Gmail intake, message cleaning and validation, AI-assisted response preparation, human-review or eligible auto-reply routing, invalid-email alerting, and outcome logging in Google Sheets.
projects.imageAlt: AI customer support email workflow screenshot
projects.contribution: My contribution: I designed and configured the email intake, validation, AI response, review-routing, and logging steps.
projects.outcome: Measured scope: six defined workflow stages across email intake, response preparation, review/routing, alerts, and logging. No verified response-time or labor-savings benchmark is currently available.

projects.title: AQSA POS System Testing
projects.description: Manual functional testing of a point-of-sale application across sales, inventory, customer records, reports, integrations, and backup workflows. The submitted test record contains 100 test cases.
projects.notes: The attached evidence includes the original report sign-off page and a chart based on the test totals recorded in the checklist.
projects.contribution: My contribution: I executed and documented test cases, compared expected and actual results, and recorded outcomes and limitations.
projects.outcome: Measured scope: 100 documented test cases across multiple POS functional areas, with supporting test evidence available as a PDF.
